## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and the frozen requirement it serves.

## Verification

- [ ] `scripts/check.ps1` passes.
- [ ] UI changes have a manual acceptance checklist.
- [ ] No image, result, model, identity vector, secret, absolute user path, or private log is included.
- [ ] New dependencies, models, nodes, datasets, or network calls have documented licenses and privacy boundaries.
- [ ] Implemented, simulated, partial, and roadmap behavior are labeled accurately.
